methodology.signal: candidate list is generated near/after the signal-day close
methodology.buy: next trading session first 5-minute VWAP = amount/volume from TDX 5m bar, unadjusted actual price
methodology.sell: 3 trading days after entry at first 5-minute VWAP; if suspended, first later tradable open5 VWAP
methodology.partial: positions not yet at the 3-day exit are marked to latest available market close
methodology.capital: 8 rotating sleeves, initial NAV=1.0; each sleeve is reused on its own 8-session rotation
methodology.rule1: equal weight within each daily sleeve
methodology.rule2: weight proportional to score within each daily sleeve
